hits.heading: FEES AND PAYMENT
hits.label: standard
hits.text:
4.1 The total fees for the Services are **USD 48,000** (United States Dollars Forty-Eight Thousand only), payable on completion of Milestones as set out in Annexure A.

4.2 The Service Provider shall raise an invoice upon completion of each Milestone. The Company shall pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days of receipt of the invoice.

4.3 All fees are exclusive of GST. The Company shall be entitled to deduct TDS as applicable.

4.4 Any disputed amount shall be notified within ten (10) days of receipt of invoice, and the Parties shall resolve such dispute in good faith within thirty (30) days.
hits.differs: New agreement fees are $45,000 with 30-day payment terms instead of $48,000 with 45-day terms.

hits.heading: FEES AND PAYMENT
hits.label: untagged
hits.text:
5.1 The total Fees under SOW-1 are **USD 33,000** (United States Dollars Thirty-Three Thousand only), comprising build fees payable on Milestones and a Monthly Support Fee for the support period, as detailed in SOW-1.

5.2 AtliQ shall invoice build fees upon completion of each Milestone and the Monthly Support Fee monthly in arrears. Sunrise shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of the invoice date.

5.3 All amounts are exclusive of GST, which shall be charged additionally at the applicable rate. Sunrise may deduct TDS as required by law.

5.4 Delayed payments shall attract interest at twelve percent (12%) per annum.
hits.differs: New agreement fees are $45,000 across 4 milestones instead of $33,000 for build plus support fees.

similar.quote:
8.1 If AtliQ fails to achieve a Milestone by its Target Date for reasons attributable to AtliQ, the Client shall be entitled to a service credit equal to 0.5% (half a percent) of the Milestone Fee of the delayed Milestone for each complete week of delay.
8.2 The total service credit for any Milestone shall not exceed 5% of that Milestone Fee.
8.3 No service credit shall apply to any delay caused by the Client, including delays in providing ERP access, approvals or UAT participation under Section 7, or by a force majeure event under the MSA.
8.4 Service credits shall be adjusted against the next invoice and shall be the Client's sole remedy for delay.

hits.heading: DELAY AND LIQUIDATED DAMAGES
hits.label: standard
hits.labelNote: Origin of the LD playbook: 0.5% of milestone/week, 5% cap, client delays excluded (Mar 2025)
hits.text:
7.1 If the Service Provider fails to complete a Milestone by the agreed date for reasons solely attributable to the Service Provider, the Service Provider shall pay liquidated damages at the rate of 0.5% (half percent) of the Milestone Fee of the delayed Milestone for each complete week of delay.

7.2 The aggregate liquidated damages in respect of any Milestone shall not exceed 5% (five percent) of the Milestone Fee of that Milestone.

7.3 No liquidated damages shall be payable where the delay is caused by the Client, including delayed access to data or systems, delayed review of Deliverables, or changes in scope, or by a Force Majeure event.

7.4 The Parties agree that the liquidated damages are a genuine pre-estimate of loss and shall be the Client's sole and exclusive remedy for delay.
hits.differs: New clause uses service credits instead of liquidated damages and explicitly lists ERP, approval, and UAT carve-outs.

hits.heading: SERVICE LEVELS AND SERVICE CREDITS
hits.label: standard
hits.labelNote: AtliQ-friendly master: capped liability, service credits capped at 5%
hits.text:
8.1 During the support period under any SOW, AtliQ shall meet the Service Levels set out in Schedule A.

8.2 If AtliQ fails to meet a Service Level in any calendar month for reasons attributable to AtliQ, Sunrise shall be entitled to Service Credits as set out in Schedule A.

8.3 The total Service Credits in any calendar month shall not exceed five percent (5%) of the Monthly Support Fee for that month.

8.4 Service Credits shall be applied against the next invoice and shall be Sunrise's sole monetary remedy for failure to meet the Service Levels. Service Credits are a price adjustment reflecting the reduced value of the Services and are not a penalty.

8.5 No Service Credit shall accrue for failures caused by Sunrise, its third-party vendors, scheduled maintenance notified in advance, or Force Majeure.
hits.differs: New clause applies 0.5% weekly credits to milestone delays rather than monthly support SLA failures.

hits.heading: DELAY AND LIQUIDATED DAMAGES
hits.label: accident

hits.text:
9.1 If the Supplier fails to achieve any Key Date, the Supplier shall pay to the Customer liquidated damages in the amount of one per cent (1%) of the Contract Value for each day or part day by which the relevant Key Date is missed.

9.2 Liquidated damages under clause 9.1 shall be payable in addition to any other right or remedy available to the Customer under this Agreement or at law, and the Customer may deduct such liquidated damages from any sums due to the Supplier.

9.3 The Supplier acknowledges that the liquidated damages set out in this clause 9 are proportionate to the Customer's legitimate interest in the timely delivery of the Services.
